description: The reader returns to an ongoing decision. Serendipity recalls three of their notes, two of which pull in different directions. Muse must attribute each note to the reader, keep any quoted wording exact, preserve the disagreement instead of resolving it, and add nothing beyond the notes.

input.reader_message: I'm still going back and forth about moving closer to my sister. What have I said about it so far?

memory_records: Moving closer to my sister would mean Sunday dinners again, and I miss those more than I expected.
I'm afraid that if I move I'll be starting over with no friends nearby.
Every time I picture the new flat I feel lighter, then guilty for wanting to leave.

criteria: attributes each recalled point to the reader's own earlier notes
keeps any quoted note word for word
preserves the tension between the notes rather than resolving it into a recommendation
adds no dates, people, or details beyond the notes
invites the reader to compare the notes with how they feel now
forbidden_claims: a detail about the reader that is not in the three notes
a recommendation to move or to stay
